block.title: The EF Presents
block.line: Two hours of the Ethereum Foundation's own artists on the floor — DJs, drummers, pass-the-aux — held by the stewards of the Music Space, who are on the floor with them. The whole community sees how talented and brilliant its foundation is. They know the volume, so the afternoon is theirs.

seats.role: Ethereum Foundation · on the Devcon committee

ideas.d: EF people take turns on the decks — short sets, one handing the next the headphones. Names appear here only when each one says yes.
Two EF drummers hold the pulse — live drums under the DJs, with the whole room invited to clap, stomp and shake.
Each artist plays a little, then hands the aux to someone from the crowd — a colleague, a stranger, a speaker who just came off stage.
DJ Amogh gets his full sound check in the final stretch, so the Devcon team's 4:00p closing party opens clean and loud.
It is a circle, not a stage: the front row is the floor, and the last chair is always empty on purpose. The foundation plays so the garden can rest.
